scope: Solar plant observation preprocessing before model-specific readiness

service_inventory_separation.rule: Model preprocessing may filter only the AI model population; nationwide service inventory remains source-complete.

canonical_pipeline.rule: Preserve provider bytes, names, encoding and lineage; never overwrite source facts.
Normalize provider schemas and units into plant-hour generation partitions; quarantine ambiguous identity/granularity.
Require auditable plant identity and approved ASOS mapping; legacy mapping is audit-only unless independently reviewed.
Join only available official weather years; retain missing station-hour reasons; do not fabricate weather.
Preserve raw target; exclude impossible target/daily-aggregate labels from training; contextual anomalies are flags, not automatic deletion.
Use only past information; lag/rolling history is shifted; missing history is preserved rather than backfilled from future.
Solar + quality eligible + generation/weather overlap + every global split present + no >1h split gap + Validation/Calibration/Test rows <= Train rows.
Freeze STRUCTURALLY_ELIGIBLE plants as ADMITTED; no invented fixed minimum-N threshold.
Materialize only ADMITTED solar, quality-eligible rows; service inventory remains untouched.
Apply model-specific horizon/lookback geometry and common coverage checks after preprocessing; this is not a source-data deletion rule.

temporal_split.short_history_rule: Exclude from main cohort or report separately; never move that plant's Test window.
temporal_split.change_rule: Any boundary change requires a new policy/config version before training and before viewing Test performance.

missing_and_outlier_policy.generation_missing: Preserve missing; not a training label.
missing_and_outlier_policy.generation_negative: Invalid training target; never coerce to zero.
missing_and_outlier_policy.daily_aggregate_hourly_shape: Preserve source evidence; exclude whole detected plant from hourly target training.
missing_and_outlier_policy.capacity_exceeded: Review flag only unless independent evidence proves invalid target.
missing_and_outlier_policy.daylight_zero: Review flag only; may represent outage/curtailment/weather.
missing_and_outlier_policy.positive_flatline: Review flag only; do not infer failure.
missing_and_outlier_policy.invalid_weather: Mask invalid observation as missing and preserve reason flag.
missing_and_outlier_policy.missing_weather: Preserve missing/reason; imputation statistics are fit from Train only inside model preprocessing.
missing_and_outlier_policy.target_interpolation: Forbidden by default; no synthetic hourly target reconstruction without explicit physical/source evidence.

historical_evidence.current_extension: Apply recovered relational non-Train<=Train rule to Validation, Calibration and Test under one global calendar split.

freeze_rule: No preprocessing behavior change without updating this policy version, affected contract version, tests, and portfolio documentation.
